Name: (CP) Exotic Livestock animals
Author: Whited117
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/v8TEQqH.png[/img][/center]

[center][b][color=#f1c232][i]Exotic Livestock Animals[/i] (ELA) [/color]expands your farming horizons by introducing a collection of [color=#1e84cc]exotic species[/color] with unique mechanics. From the deep jungle to prehistoric times, these new companions do more than just look good—they automate tasks, produce valuable resources, and unlock never-before-seen artisanal recipes. Turn your barn into an exotic sanctuary!

[/b][/center]
[center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/rXnBTV8.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]New Barn Animals[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Utility Mechanics: Automate: [/color]animal petting  or boost your crops with specialized fertilizer.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Artisanal Production Chain:[/color] New machines like the Sugar Processor and exclusive goods such as Sugar Cane Rum and Flamingo Mayonnaise.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Gameplay Balance:[/color] New items designed to enhance farm efficiency while maintaining the original game's economy.[/b][/center]



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/uwXOYhM.png[/img][/center]

[center][b][color=#f1c232]1. Download the mod,
2. unzip
3. copy files
4. paste all files into mod folder.[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#fff2cc]Requieres:[/color][color=#f1c232] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Config
[/url][/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/sUYczpk.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Game Version:[/color][/b] Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]SMAPI:[/color] Requires SMAPI  version 4.5.1 or above installed.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Animal Mods:[/color] Compatible with most mods that add new animals.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Multiplayer:[/color] Works correctly in co-op mode (all players have the mod installed).[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Bugs:[/color] If you find a bug, Let me know.[/b][/center]
[center][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8a6FXl0.png[/img]
[b]
[color=#f1c232]Art Credits:[/color] All animal and item art is original or used under permitted license. Redistribution of these assets in other projects is not allowed without prior consent.
[color=#f1c232]Mod Usage:[/color] This mod is provided "as is". While it has been tested, I'm not responsible for any potential data loss or conflicts with other mods. It's highly recommended to back up your save file before installation. [/b]
[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dmV3RKe.png[/img]
[/center]
